description: Delete ONE entry from the user's log: a food, exercise, weigh-in or water entry. Read get_today/get_day first — each item in `recent` carries its `id` and `type`; pass both. Deleting a weigh-in updates their current weight to the newest remaining one. This can't be undone, so confirm with the user first. Needs the user's "Delete entries" switch for this connection (whatevr app → Settings → Connections). The user is notified.
name: delete_log
